meta.name: seo-audit
meta.description: Audit affiliate blog posts and landing pages for SEO issues. Triggers on: "audit my blog post for SEO", "check my SEO", "SEO review", "improve my rankings", "SEO checklist", "on-page SEO audit", "keyword optimization check", "why isn't my page ranking", "SEO score", "content quality audit", "check my meta tags", "internal linking audit", "quick SEO wins".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审核网页SEO问题并给出改进建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要提升博客或落地页的搜索引擎排名
copy.tagline_en: Automatically audit web pages for SEO issues and get improvement suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to improve search engine rankings of your blog posts or landing pages

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能审核你的博客文章或落地页的SEO问题，分析关键词、元标签、内容质量等，输出10维度评分卡和按优先级排序的修复清单。
howto.when: 当你说出“audit my blog post for SEO”、“check my SEO”等触发短语，或要求做SEO审核时接管。

say.text: 审核我的博客文章SEO，关键词是“最佳AI视频工具”。
say.note: Claude会输出评分卡和修复清单

say.text: 检查我的落地页SEO，目标关键词“HeyGen评测”。
为什么我的页面排名不高？帮我做SEO审核。
say.note: Claude会诊断问题并提供修复

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can audit your blog post or landing page for SEO issues, analyzing keywords, meta tags, content quality, etc., and output a 10-dimension scorecard with a prioritized fix-it checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like 'audit my blog post for SEO', 'check my SEO', etc., or request an SEO review.

say_en.text: Audit my blog post for SEO, keyword is 'best AI video tools'.
say_en.note: Claude will output scorecard and checklist

say_en.text: Check my landing page SEO, target keyword 'HeyGen review'.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and give recommendations

say_en.text: Why isn't my page ranking? Do an SEO audit.
